decision.explanation: The sources D1S4, D2S1, and D3S4 each provide a different date (March 2, 2021; May 13, 2021; and July 29, 2021) associated with the 2021 NBA Draft. These are distinct claims about the same referent (the draft date), and none of the provided audits or source contexts resolve the conflict definitively. Since the instruction requires preserving separately valid referents and complementary answers, all three dates are retained.
